B. They are non-reactive - This is incorrect as organometallic compounds are known for their high reactivity.

C. They are nonflammable - This contradicts the known characteristic of organometallic compounds being highly flammable.

D. They are nontoxic - While some organometallic compounds may not be highly toxic, many are, and toxicity is not their primary hazard.
